name: pdf-palm
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,shutil
print(shutil.which('pdftotext'))
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/1912.05775.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
print(r.returncode,r.stderr[:300],len(r.stdout))
s=r.stdout
sys.stdout.write(s[:14500])
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','sources/1912.05775.txt'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);print(w.stdout,w.stderr)
sys.exit(r.returncode or w.returncode)
